channel.title: Maccy
channel.description: Most recent changes with links to updates.

item.description:
• Updated app icon for Liquid Glass.
  • Increased the minimum popup height to 3 history items.
  • Enabled Portuguese translation.
  • Enabled Khmer translation.
  • Fixed paste without formatting not pasting.
  • Fixed bug freeze due to a closed preview still receiving mouse events.
  • Fixed selection jump to the previous item when deleting the first unpinned item.
  • Fixed crash when copying the bottom-most pinned item at full capacity.
  • Fixed preview shortcut registering as a global hotkey.
  • Fixed height increasing upon preview open, even though it's sufficient.
  • Fixed a double separator when history has no non-pinned items.
  • Fixed preview text not taking up the width.
